topic: The secret tunnel under the Berlin Wall that freed 57 people in one night
hook: A secret tunnel under the Berlin Wall freed 57 people in one night.
script: A secret tunnel under the Berlin Wall freed 57 people in one night. In 1964, students dug a 145-metre tunnel from West Berlin into the East. It took months. The tunnel was barely wide enough to crawl through. On one night alone, 57 East Germans escaped to freedom. The tunnel was discovered the next day. 57 lives changed forever. Follow for history's greatest escape stories.
